audit.whatIsWrong: Rated 'Even, 6/10' on a 56.09% win rate over 583 games where the packet chart gives Gangplank every stage after level 1.
audit.why: Nothing in the page's own text describes an even lane — it says he out-ranges her, cleanses her ult, and two-taps her late.
audit.corrected: diff FAV, tone green, diffRating 4/10, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts called Levels 4-5 and Level 6 'Skill'; the packet chart gives both to Gangplank, and the page's own whys[3] ('your barrel poke beats her kite') and whys[4] ('you flip her 6 spike into a wasted combo') agree with the packet.
audit.why: Level 6 in particular is a Gangplank stage precisely because Remove Scurvy cleanses Lilting Lullaby — calling it even undersells the single best interaction in the matchup.
audit.corrected: win[3], win[4], phases[3].side and phases[4].side flipped to Gangplank as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page gives Lillia a dash in nine places ('dash kite', 'her dash poke', 'bait her dash', 'before she dashes in', 'when she's not dashing'). Lillia has no dash. Blooming Blows passively grants STACKING MOVE SPEED when she hits enemies with spells — that is what she kites on. Separately, the whole full layer tracks 'Blooming Blows' as the matchup-defining cooldown when the ability that decides the lane is Lilting Lullaby (150/130/110s), and Blooming Blows' outer edge deals TRUE damage, which nothing on the page mentions.
audit.why: 'Bait her dash' is advice for a button she does not have — the player waits for a cast that never comes while she simply walks away on stacked move speed. And the true-damage edge means armour misreads the trade.
audit.corrected: Dash removed everywhere in favour of move-speed stacks; the full layer's tracked cooldown moved to Lilting Lullaby with its real 150s number; true damage added to breakdown.cooldowns.
sources: enemyKit — no dash flag on any slot

edits.before: "Levels 1-2 are the only window she really gets, and even then it's close — Parrrley out-ranges her, so punish her every time she walks up to last-hit. Don't chase her movement speed across the lane; she'll kite your autos with her dash and bleed you with Dream Dust DOT. Sit on the wave, hit her with Q when she comes for CS, and don't let her free-hit your low-HP barrels before you can use them. She has no point-and-click and no gap-closer that catches you — she only out-trades if you over-walk into her poke."
edits.after: "Levels 1-2 are the only window she really gets, and even then it's close — Parrrley out-ranges her, so punish her every time she walks up to last-hit. Don't chase her across the lane; Blooming Blows stacks move speed every time she lands a spell, so she kites your autos and bleeds you with Dream Dust. Sit on the wave, hit her with Q when she comes for CS, and don't let her free-hit your low-HP barrels before you can use them. She has no point-and-click and no dash at all — she only out-trades if you over-walk into her poke."

edits.before: "This is where you take over. With your second Q and a keg point you start landing Parrrley-into-keg poke, and she has to walk into a slow she can't dodge to farm. At 6 her R looks scary, but Remove Scurvy is the answer — let the drowsy tick, then W to cleanse it instantly and heal off missing HP, and she's burned her whole combo for nothing. Bait her dash, drop a barrel where she lands, and Q-detonate to slow her out of the kite. She cannot duel you if you don't chase blindly into her poke."
edits.after: "This is where you take over. With your second Q and a keg point you start landing Parrrley-into-keg poke, and she has to walk into a slow she can't dodge to farm. At 6 her R looks scary, but Remove Scurvy is the answer — let the drowsy tick, then W to cleanse it instantly and heal off missing HP, and she's burned a 150-second ult for nothing. Pre-place a barrel on the ground she must farm from and Q-detonate as she steps in, so the slow strips her move-speed stacks. She cannot duel you if you don't chase."

edits.before: "You own the late game outright — she's a roaming skirmisher, not a 1v1 threat, and chained keg detonations two-tap her squishy AP frame the moment she's in range. Cannon Barrage zones her off Dragon and Baron and punishes how slowly she clears a side lane when she's not dashing. Keep W up for her R in fights and she has no way to lock you down. Her only out is avoiding you entirely and snowballing elsewhere — so don't let her free-roam, group your kegs, and close the game before she's relevant."
edits.after: "You own the late game outright — she's a roaming skirmisher, not a 1v1 threat, and chained keg detonations two-tap her squishy AP frame the moment she's in range. Her only out is avoiding you entirely and snowballing elsewhere — so don't let her free-roam, group your kegs, and close the game."

notes: Lillia was given a dash in nine places across this page — she has none. Everything is now written around Blooming Blows' stacking move speed instead. The missingInteractions file suggests Swirlseed 'cuts your retreat' via a terrain flag, but Riot's own description says the seed rolls until it hits a wall or a target — it does not create terrain — so I did not write that claim in. The Blooming Blows true-damage edge is real per Riot's text and is now stated. packet.suspectNames flagged "Lilting Lullaby's" in spikes[1]: false positive, it is the possessive.
